issue.title: test_axe_constrained_width_no_wrap_png_snapshot snapshots the AXE detail pane before its status block renders, so the golden fails under CPU contention
issue.description:
tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_axe_layout.py::test_axe_constrained_width_no_wrap_png_snapshot is a reproducible visual convergence flake against golden tests/ace/tui/visual/snapshots/png/axe_constrained_width_no_wrap_60x30.png. Found while landing epic sase-o9; NOT caused by it (proof below).

SYMPTOM: every failure has the identical signature -- changed 23145/586500 pixels (3.946292%), 23144 material at threshold 8. Decoding the failure artifact's actual.svg shows the AXE detail pane missing its whole summary block ('Status: * running', 'Interval: 60s', 'Cycles: 12', 'Errors: 0', 'Chops run: 24'); the pane instead starts at 'CHOPS' and grows a vertical scrollbar. The frame is captured before the dashboard summary fields are populated, so this is an unconverged render, not golden drift or renderer variance.

REPRODUCTION (workspace sase_13):
  just test-visual-contention -- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_axe_layout.py
  -> at the default 26 workers on 2 CPUs, HEAD 26fefdab7: 3 of 4 runs red.
  -> at SASE_VISUAL_CONTENTION_WORKERS=18: HEAD 2 of 2 red; pre-epic base 92934cb04 2 of 3 red.
It also fires in the ordinary lane: the sase-o9 landing gate run (monitor 5fegfcvzqvqs, 2026-08-17) failed exactly this node on gw3, 1 failed / 699 passed / 1 skipped.

PASSES WITHOUT CONTENTION: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -m visual -p no:randomly on the node alone (1 passed) and on the whole file (2 passed); 'just test-visual -- <file>' at 12 workers passed; 'just test-visual -- <node>' passed; three direct '-n 2 --dist=worksteal' runs passed. So an unloaded host hides it, which is why it survives ordinary visual-lane runs.

NOT CAUSED BY EPIC sase-o9: the byte-identical 23145/586500 signature reproduces at 92934cb04, the commit immediately before the epic's first commit cc805197b. sase-o9 touches only proc_observer, procs_pane*, proc_gear_chips, proc_indicator, _member_jump, help_modal/binding_common, docs/ace.md, and the config-center Procs visual helpers -- nothing in the AXE dashboard or its settle path.

LIKELY ROOT CAUSE: the test settles with only 'await page.expect_screen_not_contains("IDLE")' then 'wait_for_visual_idle(page)'. Neither waits on the AXE detail summary block, so under CPU starvation the snapshot wins the race against the status fields. The sibling test in the same file already force-settles the footer by hand before snapshotting, with a comment saying the AXE footer repaint can lag the tab change under xdist -- the same gap, patched narrowly for one widget.

SUGGESTED FIX: wait on a concrete marker of the loaded summary (for example expect the screen to contain 'Chops run:') before ace_png_visual.assert_page_png, or teach wait_for_visual_idle about the AXE detail pane, rather than rebaselining the golden. Do not accept the unconverged frame with --sase-update-visual-snapshots.

VERIFY WITH: just test-visual-contention -- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_axe_layout.py, repeated, expecting green.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-ny — owns 7 ACE PNG goldens that fail deterministically in the SERIAL visual lane (-n 0) and explicitly enumerates its nodes; this node is not among them and passes serially, so it is a distinct convergence defect, but both land in tests/ace/tui/visual and a rebaseline done for sase-ny must not sweep this golden in.

RELATED: sase-oe, sase-og, sase-n5, sase-nf, sase-nl — sibling node-specific 'passes in isolation, fails under the full parallel lane' tasks. This one differs in kind: it is a render-convergence race in a PNG snapshot's settle path rather than process-global state leaking between tests, so it is out of scope for epic sase-j7's leak-detector work.

PROPOSED BY: the sase-o9 land agent while running the epic's check-full gate lineup (monitor 5fegfcvzqvqs). The gate lineup is otherwise green on the landing tree; this node was the only failure and is proven pre-existing at 92934cb04.

evidence.note: Independently reproduced while implementing tribe_panel_settled_monitor_gear.md (unrelated tree). tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_axe_layout.py::test_axe_constrained_width_no_wrap_png_snapshot failed as part of a just test-visual full run (4 failures total, 3 of which were confirmed unrelated to my diff) while several other concurrent agents (sase-pq.land, sase-pw.5, sase-pw.8, 06l) were running just check/just check-full/just test-visual in the same shared workspace directory sase_22 -- consistent with this bead's CPU-contention diagnosis. Confirms the flake is still present.

Independent reproduction on 2026-08-18 while verifying the unrelated beads_detail_drop_readiness_row tale.

just test-visual with 4 workers (suite-gate bypassed because a long-lived scoped holder left the host pool below the 4-token floor) failed tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_axe_layout.py::test_axe_constrained_width_no_wrap_png_snapshot with the exact signature this bead names: 23145/586500 (3.946292%), 23144 material. Actual PNG is missing Status/Interval/Cycles/Errors/Chops run and shows a vertical scrollbar; golden has the full summary block.

Serial rerun on the same tree (SASE_PYTEST_WORKERS=1 just test-visual -- that node plus five siblings) passed this node in 1.59s. Confirms the CPU-contention settle-path race, not golden drift and not caused by the Beads Readiness-row removal.

Same 4-worker run also failed the sibling node tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_axe.py::test_axe_chop_overrun_narrow_png_snapshot with 38412/809216 (4.746817%) and the same missing-summary-block signature; that sibling also passed in the serial rerun. Same root cause (snapshot before the AXE detail status block paints). Did not update either golden.

Reproduced again during epic sase-qd landing: phase bead sase-qd.5's full 'just test-visual' run (2026-08-19, workspace sase_15 tree at 60bc31150) failed this node alone with the same ~3.9% changed-pixel signature while 720 other visual tests passed, and the node passed cleanly in isolation under 'pytest -p no:xdist -m visual'. Confirms the contention-only convergence race is still live on master and still costs one red node per full visual lane run.

payload.close_reason: Fixed by 72f93fb1f 'fix: stabilize visual closeout and verification gates' (2026-08-21), doing exactly what the bead asked -- wait for the dashboard summary fields rather than accepting the transient. tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_axe_layout.py added _axe_long_label_summary_populated(), which requires 'review_pipeline', 'success', and '1.0s' to be present in the status and output sections, plus _pin_axe_output_top() with an explicit scroll wait, before capturing. Verified 2026-08-24 at 45806495f.
